long_biography.plain_text:
Businessman Ziyad Manasir began trading while studying engineering in the Soviet Union, buying and selling computers and cars before moving into commodities. His purchase of a construction factory in Tyumen led to work building homes for Gazprom employees. These ventures preceded his return to Jordan, where he started a chemicals and fertilizer distributor with just 15 employees in 1999.

His charitable foundation, established in 2014, is funded personally and does not accept donations. It supports a research and innovation award aimed at solutions to Jordan's development needs. Manasir chairs its board of trustees.
